notes.title: LOVE IS ALL AROUND-Japanese Dubbed Version DLC is now available for free!
notes.notes:
We have invited Japanese voice actors to dub 'LOVE IS ALL AROUND' in Japanese.
Users who have  'LOVE IS ALL AROUND' can directly download the Japanese dubbed version of the DLC for experience!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190324/f043ed7c3e05de37597486b568e9f85ac3c93f00.png

Language switching instructions
1. Download this DLC, open "LOVE IS ALL AROUND" and click "Settings".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190324/2e2bc4ac23703ce0b0442b67e83283a6fad4c0ce.jpg

2. You can switch between "voice language" and "text language" to Japanese in the settings interface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190324/93cc94d76ca4d66f334e45c7ad72c52fb2900710.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881050/_/

notes.title: "Love Is All Around" official version will be released on October 18th (GMT+8)
notes.notes:
We would like to express our gratitude to all the players for your continuous support and attention. The official version of the game will be available for $9.99, with a 10% discount during the first week. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190324/4bb3cde2e62b05e554447181486ef88b6e6f54a9.png
Get ready for a delightful and romantic adventure as we embark on this journey together! 
Mark your calendars for October 18th, 2023(GMT+8). Don't miss it!
